unit.title: Factoring and Quadratic Equations
unit.role: Use reverse multiplication to expose zeros and develop the full quadratic-solving toolkit.
unit.governingQuestion: How can hidden product structure reveal solutions?
unit.storyArc: Factoring reverses distribution, then the zero-product property turns factors into solutions. Square roots, completing the square, and the quadratic formula provide increasingly general methods, culminating in strategic choice.
outcomes: Factor using GCF, grouping, trinomial, and special-product methods.
Determine whether factoring is complete in the chosen number system.
Solve quadratics by factoring and the square-root method.
Complete the square geometrically and algebraically.
Derive and use the quadratic formula and discriminant.
unit.investigation: Choose the most efficient method for a mixed set of quadratic equations and defend each choice.
unit.mastery: Students must solve, check, and justify method selection across all four major techniques.
